name: Ilja Dragunov
profileSummary: Ilja Rukober, known by his ring name Ilja Dragunov is a Russian-German professional wrestler. He is signed to WWE, where he performs on the SmackDown brand and is a former one-time WWE United States Champion. He formerly competed on the NXT UK and NXT brands, where he won each brand's main title: the NXT United Kingdom Championship and the NXT Championship. He is the first non-kayfabe Russian-born male wrestler to compete and win a championship in the WWE.
